title: SPI slave (mode 0, MSB first): a byte shifted in on MOSI while the TX byte shifts out on MISO
features: SPI slave, mode 0 (CPOL = 0, CPHA = 0), MSB first, 8-bit frames.
MOSI is sampled on each SCLK rising edge while CSn is low; MISO shifts out the TX byte, starting with bit 7.
CSn high resets the bit counter, so each frame starts on a byte boundary.
RX reads the receive shift register, which holds a complete byte when IRQ BYTE is set; TX is the byte sent in the next frame and reads back.
Interrupt BYTE once per received byte.

words.name: TX
words.desc: Byte shifted out on MISO in the next transfer

words.name: RX
words.desc: Last byte shifted in on MOSI

irqs.name: BYTE
irqs.desc: a byte was received (eighth SCLK rising edge)

notes: sclk, mosi, miso and csn are the SPI pins; they pass through unchanged. MISO is high-Z while CSn is high, so several targets can share it. SCLK is sampled on clk: it must stay high and low at least two clocks each.
